notes.title: Slayer Edition - Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/d72e4e97939e60472e34a484ffd3b02d7f9dd5a8.png[/img]

Hello Everyone, 

Thanks for your feedback on the Slayer Edition update for Chaosbane, we understand this brought a few unexpected issues, these should have been resolved with the patch we're putting out today. If you're still experiencing issues, then please leave a post in the forums. 

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Witch Hunter skill 'Castigate' now generates energy correctly 
[*] Witch Hunter weapon name fixed (FR Localization)
[*] Witch Hunter voice over synchronization has been fixed
[*] Widescreen Resolution crashes have been fixed
[*] Trophies only unlocking for host in MP now correctly unlock for all players.
Trophies that should have been unlocked due to the bug above should be automatically unlocked at next launch of the save file.
[*] Issues where the FPS would drop in the inventory have been resolved. 
[*] Issue where the loot would drop outside the reachable area have been resolved. 
[*] Witch Hunter "Sigmar's Icons" has been fixed
[*] Relic Hunts in the cemetery was sometimes be unclearable, this is now resolved. [/list]

notes.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane - Slayer Edition Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/180c95ed0e58d36ea25c2caf17ddc7f1bfc6ae8e.png[/img]
We're excited to announce the release of the Slayer Edition of Warhammer: Chaosbane onto Steam. The Slayer Edition is a new package for the game, which includes all of the content that's been released for Chaosbane thus far, including the Tomb Kings, and the Witch Hunter. The price of the Slayer Edition varies depending on what DLC you own.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16609/Warhammer_Chaosbane__Slayer_Edition/
Alternatively, you can purchase the Witch Hunter separately. The Slayer Edition, and Witch Hunter release alongside a number of [u][b]FREE[/b][/u] updates to the core experience, bringing new zones, new enemies, and more. You can find the full list in the patch notes: 

[h1]Patch Notes: [/h1]
[list][*]Release of the Witch Hunter
[i]Jurgen Haider, the Witch Hunter makes his way into Warhammer: Chaosbane. The Witch Hunter is able to switch between 2 styles, either getting up close and personal with his sword, or exhausting the gunnery school's ammo reserves as you rain down bullets on those who would oppose you. (Witch Hunter DLC Required)[/i][/list]

notes.title: Tower of Chaos Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/5f86090e4f00d6c4918113bb97c9ceed8894b6f2.png[/img]

Welcome to the Tower of Chaos heroes! 

We hope you're ready to take on the challenge offered by the Tower of Chaos, the newest game mode in Warhammer: Chaosbane. The premise is simple, the higher you climb, the better the reward, and tougher the challenge. If you fail, then you'll be walking away with nothing but a bruised ego. The tower is accessible after you've cleared the Act 2. 

There's a lot of other things included in this patch, changes to Boss Rush and Relic Hunt, a new currency called Morrisleb coins, balance tweaks, and much more. So make sure you read on for the full patch notes. 

Before you go, we wanted to thank you all for all the support we've received over the past year. Your feedback has helped shape the development of Warhammer: Chaosbane in. We're not done yet either, we've got something special planned, so put down your cloaks for now, and stay tuned. We'll be back with more information later this year.

Anyway, let's move onto the patch notes:

[b]HOTFIX:[/b][list][*] Keela can now reclaim rewards in the Invasion mode. 
[*] Fixed some UI problems when not using the 16/9 aspect ratio.
[*] Resolved some miscellaneous crash fixes.[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*] [b]New Mode Added – The Tower Of Chaos[/b][list][*] The Tower of Chaos is a new arena in which you can test your skills in various battle challenges, the higher you climb, the better quality loot you’ll receive. After you clear each floor, you can decide whether to take the rewards and end your journey here or push onward for better rewards. [/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Relic Hunt and Boss Rush Rework[/b][list][*]More options have been given to the player, to choose the maps and modifiers they’re interested in playing. You’ll receive better loot based on what modifiers you select and will be able to custom-tune the challenge.[/list][/list][list][*] Added the possibility to chain some skills during the use of other combat skills without interrupting animations
[*]Cosmetic menu added, allowing you to replace the visuals of your gear with other gear you own
[*]Inventory and the Stash can now be reorganized by the player using the mouse.
[*]Left-click can now be reconfigured on the Mouse to make it exclusively for movement.[/list][list][*][b]New enemies have been added to Act 1:[/b][list][*]New Nurgle Cultists
[*]Explosive Nurgling
[*]Chaos Sorcerer
[*]Aspiring Chaos Champion of Nurgle
[*]Minotaur
[*]Shaman Gor[/list][/list][list][*][b]New enemies have been added to Act 3:[/b][list][*] Slaanesh Assassin Cultist
[*] Chaos Sorcerer

[*] Minotaur
[*] Shaman Gor[/list][/list][list][*][b]New enemies have been added to Act 4:[/b][list][*]Apprentice Cultist of Tzeentch

notes.title: Tomb King DLC - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/7e149e791a231e349cf96f760dc83ad7afa466e0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Tomb Kings[/h3][list][*] Tomb King Content is now live![list][*] New Story Added
[*] New passive skills added
[*] New matchmaking filters added
[*] Tomb Kings added to Relic Hunting mode (for TK owners)[/list][/list]
The Tomb Kings DLC is out now available! We’ve wrote a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/774241]detailed post about this one[/url], but the TL:DR is that Magnus Edition and Season Pass owners can already access the content, or it can be purchased separately.

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*] Option to display a large map has been added
[*] New Icons have been added to the mini map (teleportation stones, chests, red + green loot, etc.)
[*] Game automatically pauses when a controller is disconnected
[*] Enemy name has been added above the life-bar of semi bosses
[*] Cursor size can be changed in the Graphical Options menu
[*] The mouse cursor changes when interactions are possible
[*] The archetype video is only played the first time a character is used
[*] New tutorial added for using presets 
[*] Walk + Run speed has been adjusted for quest NPCs
[*] Gateway selection zone has been increased
[*] Icon has been changed for “Talisman of the Predator”
[*] It’s now possible to switch between builds while surrounded by enemies, or just after receiving damage[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3][list][*] Characters no longer flash white when under the effect of a DoT spell
[*] Invoking enemies are now invulnerable during their invocation animation
[*] Nuln’s Relic Hunting now requires more enemies to be killed for completion
[*] Bosses now give more God Fragments
[*] Relic Hunting chests now give more loot and more God Fragments
[*] The last level of the Collector’s Guild (Loopable) gives less Link Fragments (20, down from 100)
[*] Enemies can now resist attraction/repulsion effects when the actions are chained
[*] Heroic Jewels trigger effects have been adjusted for critical hits, only direct skills are taken into account (passives, status, counter-attack etc. no longer trigger this effect)
[*] Keeper of Secrets: Damage decreased and life pillars decreased
[*] High difficulty bosses now deal increased damage
[*] Tzeentch relic hunting modifiers have been adjusted, tornadoes damage and knockback distance has been reduced[/list]

[h3]Vollen Balance[/h3][list][*] Benediction of Sigmar: Duration increased to 18s for each rank (from 16), energy regen reduced to 2 (from 3) for rank 2, and the damage bonus has been increased to 40% for rank 3 (from 30%)
[*] Bastion of Sigmar: Stun probability increased to 100% for all ranks
[*] Herald of Sigmar: Armor reduction for enemies has been increased to 30% (from 25), duration increased to 10s (from 5) for all ranks
[*] Blade of Vengeance: Damaged halved, but number of charges doubled 
[*] “Magnus’ Gift” Hammer: Dot increased, enemies affected have a reduced healing potency. Damage increase depending on effected enemies has been removed.[/list]

[h3]Elontir Balance[/h3][list][*] Arcane Manifestation: Cooldown reduced to 45 seconds (from 55), damage reduced, explosion range reduced
[*] Walk Between Worlds: Teleport range increase to 10m (from 8m)
[*] Living Magic (Passive): Damage reduced
[*] Spiritual Prison: Cooldown decreased to 35s (from 40)[/list]

[h3]Elessa Balance[/h3][list][*] Summon health pools increased
[*] Wild Incarnation: Summon damage increased, cooldown reduced
[*] “Eternity Armor” set: Bonus increased to 400% (from 200%), however the effect now triggers on enemies with high life values (previously poisoned enemies)
[*] “Symbiosis” Bow: Damage bonus decreased to 150% (from 200%). Traps now have a bleed effect when this bow is equipped[/list]

[h3]Bragi Balance[/h3][list][*] Laceration: Attack speed and health cost increased, range decreased
[*] Scythe: Attack speed and range increased[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*] Fixed a bug where the Nurglings could be made invulnerable during the Great Unclean One boss fight
[*] Fixed an issue where some raids would fail in multiplayer
[*] Fixed the tooltip for “Scourge of Pestilence – Mastered”
[*] Fixed a bug that could result in the character appearing in the wrong place after a Boss Rush
[*] Fixed some issues with Russian localization
[*] Fixed some issues with Polish localization[/list]

notes.title: October Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/776bb1d05cdc9b06be038f7dceb4343a65a46318.png[/img]

[b]5th November Hotfix:[/b] we've applied a hotfix to Chaosbane to resolve some issues with player profiles that some users were experiencing. 

The October Update is now live on Steam! Permadeath mode has been added to Warhammer: Chaosbane, start a new character and take on the challenges of the Old World, but one where the stakes are much higher. 

That's not all we have in store, so make sure you read on for the full patch notes. 

[h1]Features:[/h1][list]
[*] Permadeath mode added to the game[/list]
Make a new character and put your heroic skills to the ultimate challenge, in hardcore mode death is permanent. In the Old World death is certain, it’s just how long you can stave it off for. Find the records of slain heroes in the Pantheon, what is the highest legendary rank you can reach we wonder. 
[list][*] Build Preset options added for equipment, skills, god skills and legendary rank bonuses.
[*] Chaos 8 Difficulty added
[*] All elite enemies are now marked with an icon above their head, this way you can easily spot them as they still have their own specific loot list with better chances for high quality items[/list]
[h1]Paid Content[/h1][list]
[*] New Pet DLC content has been added[/list]
[h1]Interface[/h1][list]
[*] Heroic items (red and green) are now displayed on the map
[*] Semi-bosses have been given a life gauge, they still have their specific loot list for heroic drops
[*] Legendary rank is now displayed in all interfaces
[*] New FX added to some heroic items
[*] An arrow on the map now indicates the position of faraway objectives[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1][list]
[*] ‘Damage over time resistance’ stat has been added
[*] New guild passives have been added, icons have also been updated
[*] New Relic Hunt modifiers have been added for each Chaos God[list][*] Nurgle: Regular ground AOEs inflicting poison damage
[*] Khorne: Regular ground AOEs inflicting physical damage
[*] Slaanesh: Regular ground AOEs inflicting magical damage
[*] Tzeentch: Regular ground AOEs inflicting fire damage[/list]
[*] Invasion loot bonus has been increased (+100% per rank, up from +10% per rank), playing at high Invasion rank will give you better chances to loot heroic items[/list]
[h1]Balancing:[/h1][list]
[*] High level enemy HP gauge reworked
[*] The loot bonus from ‘Death Benediction’ is now 200% (from 100%)
[*] The gold loot bonus from the guild skill is 20% (up from 10%) and the loot rate bonus 200% (up from 100%)
[*] Relic hunt modifier that reduced critical hit rate is -50% (previously -100%)
[*] Resurrection costs increased, 15% of all gold or 50 fragments of each colour (up from 10% and 20)
[*] Enemy kill requirement in Act 1 – Quest 1 has been increased[/list]
[h1]Elessa[/h1][list]
[*] Health regeneration skill bonuses have been reduced
[*] ‘Crippling Blade’ slow effect rate has been decreased
[*] ‘Elven Shot’ slow effect rate has been decreased
[*] ‘Follow Tracks – Superior’ life regen effect has been decreased
[*] ‘Wild Incarnation’ summoned pets deal increased damage
[*] ‘Lone Hunter’ damage reduction effect has been decreased from 50%/60%/60% to 40%/40%/40%[/list]
[h1]New Loot Items Added[/h1][list]
[*] New ring added: Improves DOT damage after using your archetype ability
[*] New necklace: Improved loot drop quality based on critical hit, when you use this item there’s a chance to spawn an elite enemy with a unique loot list. [/list]
[h1]Item Balancing[/h1][list]
[*] The Axe ‘The Impatient One’ now grants 50% life bonus, 50% energy bonus and decreased cooldown of 20s (down from 100%, 100% and 100s)

notes.title: September Update (1.08)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/df7e5681df88eb005c6f632642d176078348f8d1.png[/img]

The September update is here, bringing with it the Legendary Rank system which includes some new abilities, a rework of the blessing system and much more. 

[h1]New features and improvements[/h1][list]
[*] Legendary Ranks added[/list]
Once you reach maximum level, keep earning XP in order to increase your legendary rank. This menu is accessible from your character sheet by selecting “Legendary Rank” at the bottom of the screen.[list]
[*] Blessing System Update[/list]
The blessing system is now deeper, identical for all characters, and you see the result of the craft prior to validation. 

[b]Please Note:[/b] You are going to need a lot of fragments! Keep in mind that more fragments drop when you use “Bloodlust” on enemies. Do not forget you can swap fragments at the Collector’s guild. 
[list][*] Improved the God Skill Tree ergonomics[/list]
You can now click any node on the tree and unlock the whole tree up to this node if you have enough favor points. You can cancel one or multiple nodes the same way. This will let you test multiple combinations.
[list][*] Added a new heroic set as T4 (red) and T5 (green) for each character.[/list] 

[h1]Season Pass Content[/h1][list]
[*] Additional God Skill Tree[/list]
Each character will receive an additional god skill tree with new nodes, passive and active abilities. It’s possible to invest points across both skill trees to customize a build that works for you as a player. 

[h1]All Characters[/h1][list]
[*] Added a new statistic "damage over time" (DOT). All damage over time abilities are now linked to this specific statistic and not raw damage.
[*] Reworked the balance between energy gain and damage from skills that generate energy.[/list]

[b]Empire Soldier[/b][list]
[*] The "Taunt" skill improved by the "Meteoric Iron" armor set now has the correct damage set for enemies.

[*] The aura granted with the "Grimnir’s tatoos" set has been decreased, damage decreased, bonus damage linked to your % of life lost increased, flaming visual effect removed.
[*] “Avenging charge” damage decreased.
[*] Added a damage bonus for allies when using the improved version of “Call of Oath”.
[*] Changed the bonus granted from the "Last Song" set: it now improves the "Deep gashes" passive skill.
[*] Fixed the “Strike of the Anvil” skill bonuses (Mastered version), these now apply correctly. [/list]

[b]Wood Elf[/b][list]
[*] Fixed the hitbox of “Elven Shot” so smaller enemies can be hit better and increased range of action when using the “Mastered” version of the skill.
[*] Fixed the distance at which Dryads appear when using “Call of the spirits".
[*] “Tactical retreat” has been balanced.
[*] “Lone hunter” has been balanced.[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1][list]
[*] DOT no longer kills players when they remove more than 5% of total health at once.
[*] DOT do less damage in very high difficulty levels.
[*] Removed controller vibration on skills that inflict DOT.[/list]

[h1]Gear[/h1][list]
[*] Critical damage stats added to amulets. 
[*] Bonuses adjusted for “The impatient One” and “Heart-Seeker” Slayer axes.[/list]

[h1]Enemies[/h1][list]
[*] Enemies’ attack speed rebalanced
[*] Enemies’ health and damage have been adjusted based on difficulty level.
[*] Changed enemy patterns:[list]
[*]New skills added to multiple enemies depending on their Chaos faction.[list]
[*]Khorne
Range cultists, cultist leaders, Bloodletters, Bloodcrushers, Chaos Spawns, Giant Chaos Spawns, Jabberslythes and Mutaliths now have a probability to earn a damage and defense bonus when their health is low.
[*]Nurgle
Nurglings, Cultists, range Cultists and summoners now have a probability to move away from the player when their life is low.
[*]Slaneesh
Cultists, range Cultists and summoners now briefly move away from the player when they are hurt.
For a brief moment, Cultist leaders, daemonette, Herald and Chaos Spawn have their attack speed increased when their life is low.
For a brief moment, Cultist leaders, daemonette, Herald and Chaos Spawn are immune to crowd control when their life is low.
[*]Tzeentch
Cultists, range Cultists, Blue Horrors and Pink Horrors now briefly move away from the player when they are hurt.[/list][/list]
[*] Giant Chaos Spawn do normal damages in close-quarter combat.
[*] Great Unclean One: damage done by the rock fall has been decreased.
[*] Decreased the overall number of heralds in Act 3 (in all game modes).[/list]

notes.title: Invasion Hotfix 2 & Invasion Notes (1.04)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We've pushed a small hotfix live to the Invasion Mode, read on for more details and a general guide to Invasion Mode. 

[h1]Hotfix Notes[/h1]
[list][*] Nodes now correctly unlock for all players in multiplayer.
[*] A node finished at a specific Rank now also unlock the same node on inferior Ranks, and progress isn't lost when changing Rank.
[*] Fixed some texts.[/list]

[h1]Invasion Mode Guide[/h1]
We wanted to take a moment to offer a more in-depth explanation as to how the Invasion Mode works. 

Each node represents a level with predetermined modifiers, a difficulty and a level of Chaos Corruption. The in-game difficulty level does not affect Invasion missions.

When you play Invasion, you can choose it's "Rank". The higher it is, the more resistant enemies will be (+5% per rank), hit harder (+5% damage per rank) and your chances at finding better quality items will increase (+10% Loot Quality per Rank). 

Each Invasion mission has a percentage of Chaos Corruption, this represented the life that your character loses each second. You can reduce this by unlocking certain nodes on the Invasion tree.

In multiplayer, we use the invasion card of the player who starts a mission. Progression will be saved for other players if they have access to this mission on their tree. A warning message will display if you do not meet the requirements for your progress to be recorded. 

Completed missions at higher Ranks will automatically unlock the same nodes at lower ranks. For example, if you unlock a mission at Rank 5, it will also be available for ranks 1-4. However, it will not be available for Ranks 6 and above. You can change rank at any time without losing your progress at your current rank. 

When you clear a Rank completely (100%) you unlock the next 10 ranks. So for example, if you clear Rank 7, you will unlock Ranks 8 to 18. At first you only have access to Ranks 1 to 10. 

What's the highest Rank you will clear completely? In the next update this Rank will be displayed on your character icon in Multiplayer. 


[b]Note:[/b] Relic Hunt mode, with its bonus to item quality, remains the best way to farm higher quality items (T4 Red and T5 Green). If a node is too difficult, perhaps you should gear up in Relic Hunt mode.

Read on for the full patch notes:

notes.title: Invasion Patch Delayed - Coming Next Week With New Items + More Content
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33961441/467ad1c194fdb1a3fd711879d35d4558c9003e5a.jpg[/img]

Afternoon,

The first patch is close to ready, but we’ll need a little more QA time for balancing and tuning. In part due to the inclusion of a new rarity level for gear T5 (Green), we’ve had to delay the release until next week. This additional time has allowed the team to extend the scope of the patch and ensure a high level of quality upon release. 

With that in mind, here are the current patch notes: 

[h1]Features[/h1][list]
[*] A new rarity level for gear T5 (Green) gear that provides a new upgrade for all armours, rings, weapons and amulets. 
[*] Invasion Mode [list]
[*] Over 100 nodes to explore
[*] New Unlockable Items[list]
[*] Potions (passive skills)
[*] Rings (objects)
[/list][/list]
[*]Addition of a rank system to Invasion Mode
[*] Additional Graphics Options Added[list]
[*] Depth of Field (On/Off)
[*] Temporal Anti-Aliasing (On/Off)
[*] MLAA (On/Off)
[*] Volumetric Lighting (On/Off)
[*] Option To Limit FPS[/list]
[*] Balancing Changes
[list][*] Bosses difficulty
[*] Loot drop rate
[/list][/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1][list]
[*] Passive Slots Upgraded to 6
[*] Fanity Slots Upgraded to 12
[*] Players will no longer die to DOT (Damage Over Time) effects alone
[*] 10 new levels of reputation have been added to the collector’s guild. 
[*] Missing sounds have been added
[*] Two new levels of difficulty have been added (Chaos 6 & 7)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Resolved)[/h1][list]
[*] Pets now increase pick-up radius correctly
[*] Various fixes for random crashes
[*] Various bug fixes for multiplayer
[*] Various stats related to skills have been fixed
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (In Progress)[/h1][list]
[*] Crashes in multiplayer
[*] Backup bugs (lost character progression) in multiplayer
[*] Loot drops frequency issue for multiplayer games and disappearing ground objects.
[/list]

notes.title: New Endgame Mode Added Next Week + Pre-Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33961441/467ad1c194fdb1a3fd711879d35d4558c9003e5a.jpg[/img]

Howdy Everyone,

Wanted to get back to you with some information about what's been going on, and our planned updates + patch notes for next week. Keep in mind, these aren't final, some things may change, but they should serve to give a general idea of what you can expect.

[h1]NEW GAME MODE - INVASION[/h1]

An Invasion map is played out on randomly generated levels from specific acts, Boss Fights or Arena battles with waves of enemies. Each Invasion tree node may be modified by some alterations, depending on the dark god they’re related to (poison for Nurgle, Magic Shields for Tzeentch as examples).

During this time, you’ll also be fighting against Corruption. This manifests as a life draining effect that players will have to endure. Each map has a corruption value, which becomes increasingly harsher the further a player moves away from the origin of the Invasion node trees. At the end of each invasion tree branch, you unlock powerful rewards that are exclusive to this mode, including: new skills, new heroic jewels and new potion effects.

The difficulty of Invasion is also defined by its Rank. Finishing an Invasion at a specific Rank will unlock higher Ranks and tougher Invasions. Try to find new rarity objects to become stronger and aim to complete the highest Rank possible. Invasion will release with the next patch.

[h1]Patch Notes [/h1]
[b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b][i] These are not final, but should give a general idea of what you can expect![/i]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*] Adding stages 11 through 20 for the collector’s guild.
[*] Adding an option to display loot permanently.
[*] Adding two new difficulty levels, Chaos 6 and Chaos 7.[/list]
[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list][*] Rebalancing a number of boss encounters throughout the game.
[*] Damage over time effects (poison, bleeding, etc) will no longer kill players. If a player is very low on health, DOT effects will not bring them to below 1HP.[/list]
[b]Technical Updates:[/b]
[list][*] Option added to activate or deactivate Depth of Field
[*] Option added to activate or deactivate temporal anti-aliasing.
[*] Option added to activate or deactivate MLAA.
[*] Option added to activate or deactivate volumetric lighting[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixing a bug occurring in endgame modes (Relic hunt, etc) where changing online visibility could crash the dungeon
[*] Fixing a bug that could display a boss’ life meter multiple times
[*] Fixing a bug that prevented NPCs from changing position when completing the campaign
[*] Fixing the way controls are displayed in the « revive » window
[*] Fixing the way modifiers are displayed in Relic Hunt mode
[*] Fixing a bug on filters in the skill menu
[*] Fixing a bug when trying to assign the Shift or Alt key in the key binding menu
[*] Pets will now correctly increase the loot radius
[*] Fixing a bug when the HUD is displayed in ratios other than 16/9[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list][*] Font will be changed for Japanese text[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 - Developer Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 of Warhammer: Chaosbane is live. It’s been an intense experience and a lot of hard work. Thank you to everyone who's been playing, and for all the feedback, both positive and negative. 

We’ve got a lot of data to sort through. Regardless of how much preparation you do, the first few days of launch dwarf any preparation that is done prior. We’re reading through the forums, Reddit, Social Media, Discord and bug reporting form in order to centralize your feedback. So we can break it into action points and come back to you with our next steps. 

The Bigben team is answering the community as much as possible, and they’ll be working with us to ensure you’re kept up to date about our next steps. For us at Eko, we’ve got some bugs to squash and will be spending our time and energy on improving the game. 

We have a series of plans to support, extend and improve Chaosbane. We won’t be able to solve everything in one day, but we’re dedicated to ensuring that we're moving in the right direction. 

We should have the first update next week, with an update description later this week. Bigger updates will require a little more time, especially since we’re working within a license we love, but one that needs to be respected. 

We’ve got some exciting things. So stay tuned, and once again thank you for your feedback and support. 

Chaos will be defeated!
Eko Software team.

notes.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane gets a release date, pre-order bonuses detailed
notes.notes:
Warhammer: Chaosbane, a new action RPG set in the Warhammer fantasy universe, is set for release on June 4. Along with the game's release date, Bigben and Eko Software have also announced pre-order bonuses, which will include two beta phases, starting next month.

The beta, which will be open to anyone that pre-orders the game, will be in two phases—the first is set for March, with the second following a month later in April. The beta will allow players to sample the beginning of the campaign, as well as test out the four different classes both solo and in co-op mode. Further details are expected regarding the dates and content of the beta phases at a later date.

In addition to beta access, players who preorder Warhammer: Chaosbane will receive an experience bonus which will remain active for the entirety of the character’s progression as well as a pack of four legendary crates (ah yes, computer games in 2019). You can check out further details at the official site.

Warhammer: Chaosbane was announced in June last year and might look familiar to fans of Diablo or the more recent Warhammer title, Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor—Martyr. Chaosbane will allow you to choose one of four character-based classes, each with a specific role and skillset. There's also a unique bloodlust mechanic to help take down tricky bosses, granting speed and additional powers—the duration and number of additional skills will be based on your Bloodlust level—all of which lends itself to the drop-in co-op that is present.

Warhammer: Chaosbane is set for release on June 4.
